decision: May enter a versioned secondary-literature acquisition catalog. Not an automatic primary-curve observation or trainable target/precursor export.

findings.finding: MDR is a re-edited SuperCon numerical datasheet, not an author instrument export. Preserve MDR DOI/version/row/refno and mark evidence_domain=secondary_literature.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Retain every original field and source hash; set primary verification/training eligibility false until the cited primary evidence is checked.

findings.finding: Reference numbers follow legacy journal-volume-page conventions in many cases, with other numeric identifiers also present. A row/data number does not prove a unique physical specimen, acquisition run, pressure or dopant condition. SuperCon-derived records can overlap 3DSC training evidence.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Never synthesize a DOI or specimen ID. Keep all same-source/sample/series/conditions connected during later grouping; old measured evidence is retrospective, not a prospective prediction success.

findings.finding: Oxygen/occupancy variables occur in full formula and explicit composition fields. A generated numeric-looking formula can coexist with an unresolved oxygen field. Organic common names may specify only an anion or an acronym.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Do not strip -X/+Y, assign unknown oxygen, expand chemical abbreviations without adjudication, or use formula-only matches as a phase/specimen link. The crosswalk preserves every unresolved record separately.
findings.locator: OAndM element, ma2…mj2, mo2, oz; Organic name/fullname

findings.finding: t1, t2, t3, tcsus and recommended tc denote different observables/criteria. tcn is a reported non-superconducting measurement floor. Organic tc is described as at critical or atmospheric pressure, with separate tcmax/pmax/pcrit fields.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Recommended tc cannot silently become resistive midpoint; a tcn row must not become Tc=0 or a universal negative. Verify sample, criterion, P/B and measurement window in the original before legal target export.
findings.locator: ReadMe p.5 / ReadmeTbl Oxide&Metal DB 86–94; Organic DB13–21

findings.finding: OAndM pmax is maximum pressure applied, not necessarily the pressure of every recorded Tc or rho point; field is specifically the Hall-effect magnetic field. Organic pmax is pressure of tcmax. These fields have different scopes.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Do not propagate a Hall field or maximum pressure to all modalities. Missing pressure/field remains null, never ambient/zero inferred from silence.
findings.locator: ReadmeTbl Oxide&Metal pmax DB97, field DB182; Organic pmax DB15

findings.finding: Resistivity fields describe 4.2 K, 77 K, stated normal temperature and RT, with direction-specific variants. RT is not an explicitly measured 300 K value. A database category called normal state is not proof each point is normal for its particular sample.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Preserve raw temperature/unit/normal-state evidence. Do not fabricate a 150–300 K curve or 200/225/250 K anchors from sparse scalars. Low-temperature gamma or a heat-capacity jump cannot be substituted for a frozen normal-state precursor.

findings.finding: The readme describes figure/table sets and corresponding text data for selected samples, not a blanket guarantee of original author-raw measurement files. It explicitly identifies tcfig as a filename link. Archive contains 5772 entries, including non-text objects.
findings.ingestion_boundary: Resolve explicit filename references and inspect units, measured vs calculated/digitized origin and figure/sample identity. Do not guess links from filename-number prefixes or treat every archive member as a normal-state curve.

legal_collection_route: secondary raw-field records with row/refno locators
manual primary-paper and exact sample/condition review links
only then source-checked numeric observations and criterion-specific target/precursor joins
rights_as_schema: CC BY 4.0, dataset attribution required; underlying primary-paper identity and experimental provenance remain separate
